entities.name: Khâlid-i Baghdâdî
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mawlana Khâlid Shahrazuri also known as Khâlid-i Baghdâdî and Mawlana Khalid was a Kurdish Sufi, and poet by the name of Shaykh Diya al-Dīn Khalid al-Shahrazuri, the founder of a branch of the Naqshbandi Sufi order - called Khalidi after him - that has had a profound impact not only on his native Kurdish lands but also on many other regions of the western Islamic world. His writings are among the earliest examples of prose and poetry in Central Kurdish.
